subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Which public contract should OpenClaw expose, if any, for disabling built-in skill source roots such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but adding or declining a `skills.load` opt-out changes public config semantics and built-in skill-source behavior, which repo policy treats as maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Add typed disabled sources
options.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list for built-in skill source ids, defaulting to current behavior and skipping disabled sources before discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Add personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose a smaller boolean for only the personal `.agents/skills` source, reducing API surface but leaving project-agent and future source opt-outs unresolved.

options.title: Keep current loading model
options.body: Decline new config surface and document per-skill disables, allowlists, and prompt limits as the supported controls.

recommendation.title: Add typed disabled sources
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list for built-in skill source ids, defaulting to current behavior and skipping disabled sources before discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on watcher/config/docs handling for the skills source surface and is the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
